title: Bend – A language that blocks AI mistakes via proof, on CPU and GPU
summary: Bend is a new programming language designed to prevent AI-generated code errors by integrating formal proof mechanisms directly into the language, with support for both CPU and GPU execution environments.
problem_solved: Prevents AI-generated code from producing runtime errors and logical mistakes by requiring mathematical proofs before code execution.
why_valuable: It provides formal guarantees for AI-generated code reliability, addressing the critical problem of untrustworthy outputs from AI coding assistants.
